description: A single serpent coiled into an S shape: a small hooked head with a pointed snout at the top right, a thick body looping left and back, and a tail curling to a pointed tip at the lower right.
A horse's head and neck in profile facing left, with a pointed ear and flowing mane strands, and a large feathered wing sweeping up and out to the right behind the neck.
A full-bodied unicorn standing in profile facing left: a long horn on the forehead, a raised neck with mane, a straight back, four slender legs with solid hooves, and a tail hanging at the right.
A unicorn's head and neck in profile facing left, with a long pointed horn angled up from the forehead, a small ear, a mane running down the back of the neck, and an open neck line at the bottom.
A wide, horizontally symmetric pair of parted lips showing a row of upper teeth with two long pointed fangs hanging down near either corner.

A vampire bust from the front: a bald head with pointed ears and a widow's-peak hairline, heavy angry brows, small eyes, two fangs over the lower lip, and a bow tie at the collar between sloping shoulders.
A small alien head inside a large round helmet: a single antenna with a ball tip sprouting from the upper left, and a flat-topped face with a broad rounded jaw filling the lower helmet.
A single flower seen from the side: a cupped bloom with a V-shaped petal notch at the top, a long straight stem, and two pointed leaves branching left and right at mid-height.
A blocky pixel-art alien built from square steps, symmetric about its vertical axis: two antennae at the top corners, two square eyes, stepped side arms and short legs along the bottom.

description: An open cardboard box with its two top flaps folded outward and a vertical seam on the front, with a gamepad floating just above the opening.

A laurel wreath of two leafy branches, symmetric about its vertical axis, curving up from crossed stems at the bottom, each branch carrying pairs of pointed almond leaves and a single leaf at its tip.
A racing-style gaming chair from the front: a tall rounded backrest with a headrest slot near the top, flared side bolsters, padded armrests, a seat, and a single pedestal on a splayed base.
A gnome's head from the front: a tall pointed hat flopping over to the right, large ears, two dot eyes above a round bulbous nose, and a big bushy beard tapering to a point.
A round head in profile facing left with a large rounded snout-like nose jutting out, a single oval eye, and a notched ear on the right; a stray dot sits below the head in the reference.
